fieldNotes.buildingId: Address 350 Logistics Ave geocoded ROOFTOP onto a single large warehouse/manufacturing building in River Ridge Commerce Center. Confirmed Niagara via a red 'Niagara' wall sign visible on the building's office front in a March 2026 Street View pano, and via web research (469,000 sq ft plant, opened 2019, expanded ~2020/2023).
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, or guard booth visible anywhere along the property line. The S frontage on Logistics Avenue is open behind a grass berm; the truck driveway into the dock yard is uncontrolled. truckGate false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Very deep dock apron and a large trailer yard provide 3+ truck stacking room well inside the property.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A single continuous, very long dock face runs the entire S side of the building, densely lined with trailers - estimated ~80-120 doors, band 50+. Exact count low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: The S/W dock yard is packed with rows of parked trailers - a large drop yard, capacity well over 50, band 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All docks are on one continuous building face; shipping and receiving are not on physically separate dock banks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated on-site trailer storage rows fill the dock yard south and west of the building.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Open, wide unguarded entrance leaves ample room to add an express lane if a gate were installed.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: River Ridge Commerce Center is an edge-of-town industrial park bordered by open farmland on the N and W - classed Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large plant building; the office is integrated into the SE end, not a separate structure.
